custom_commits.subject: fix: isolate owned Cargo wrapper dispatch
custom_commits.decision: Split: adopt already-merged no-config core through official distribution; drop owned Cargo-wrapper/banner/shim additions after G0.

custom_commits.subject: feat(cache): expose useful snapshot comparison and retention
custom_commits.decision: Provisional DROP: semantic comparison/retention has no demonstrated production caller. Ordinary cache save policy is not equivalent semantic usefulness.

custom_commits.subject: chore: merge official MBX 1.21.1 for cache qualification
custom_commits.decision: DROP private merge as delivery mechanism; preserve official v1.21.1 upgrade independently via PR #26.

custom_commits.subject: fix: restore immutable Cargo root pairs
custom_commits.decision: Provisional DROP: no demonstrated owned root-pair consumer; do not claim ordinary target caching reproduces these semantics.

custom_commits.subject: feat: verify native cache ownership and measure compiler events
custom_commits.decision: Provisional DROP: native ownership/compiler-event protocol not required by sampled stock consumers; retain reproducible defect evidence, not this fork.

custom_commits.subject: chore: close pinned behavioral test sources
custom_commits.decision: Provisional DROP with abandoned fork; vendored Bats closure is not evidence its tests ran or passed.

custom_commits.subject: feat: preserve MBX lineage and durable execution state
custom_commits.decision: Provisional DROP; explicitly incompatible with reviewed action comparison-report v1 parser; IPC 13/export v2 need coordinated consumers.

custom_commits.subject: feat: support verified executable and useful cache snapshots
custom_commits.decision: Provisional DROP: caller-bound executable and comparison state have no demonstrated production caller; Velnor can own verification and CLI invocation.

custom_commits.subject: merge: retain reviewed v1.6 cache trust policy
custom_commits.decision: DROP private merge as distribution; stock action v1.6.0 is independently available.

custom_commits.subject: security: verify caller-bound MBX binary digest before execution
custom_commits.decision: Provisional DROP foreign patch; verify absolute binary/hash at Velnor process boundary if that requirement becomes live.

custom_commits.subject: fix: require protected default branch for cache saves
custom_commits.decision: DROP as foreign dependency; enforce protected/default/event conditions in renderer-owned explicit save steps.

custom_commits.subject: feat(action): bind late export baseline and group
custom_commits.decision: Provisional DROP: late baseline/export-group path is not activated in sampled consumers; strict report parser rejects MBX v2.

custom_commits.subject: feat: add native supplied-document metadata checks
custom_commits.decision: Provisional DROP; real-binary test driver exists, but no proved live Velnor supplied-document requirement. No claim a wrapper reproduces private lint semantics.

custom_commits.subject: ci: restrict workflow lint push to main
custom_commits.decision: DROP with snapshot branch; this is fork CI policy, not a runtime upstream dependency.

custom_commits.subject: feat: own cache archives and foundation qualification
custom_commits.decision: Split: provisional DROP archive/SDK framework; Foundation remains STAGED-HOLD until its generated/compiled pin closure is removed or a real owner accepts a separately scoped Velnor implementation.
